annotations.title: Google Ads labels on campaigns, ad groups and ads

description: Google Ads LABELS for organising campaigns, ad groups and ads ("Made by Hermoso", "Q4 test"). action: list | create (name, color #RRGGBB, description, and targets to label at once) | update (name, color, description) | apply / remove (campaignIds, adGroupIds, ads:[{adGroupId, adId}]) | delete (confirm:true). Labels never change delivery or spend. Report by label with google_ads_report over campaign_label / ad_group_label / ad_group_ad_label.

adGroupIds.description: ad group ids to apply or remove the label on

ads.description: ads to label, as a list of {adGroupId, adId} objects

adGroupId.description: ad group the ad belongs to

campaignIds.description: campaign ids to apply or remove the label on

confirm.description: true only after the user approved a change to a LIVE campaign or a delete

customerId.description: omit to use the selected default account

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

name.description: label name, for create or update
